visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with short dark hair, wearing a dark grey tank top and light grey athletic shorts, kneels on a black rubber gym mat in a brightly lit fitness studio. He faces the camera diagonally. Behind him is a grey cable weight machine and a dark wood-paneled wall. A row of black dumbbells sits on the floor in front of him, ranging from 2.5kg upwards. (2) The man leans forward into a kneeling plank position, supporting his weight on his knees and one forearm. He uses his free hand to move the dumbbells one by one along the floor, progressing from the lightest weights toward the heavier ones. His facial expression is neutral and focused, and significant muscle definition is visible in his arms, shoulders, and chest. (3) The man continues the movement sequence, reaching the larger 30kg, 35kg, and 40kg dumbbells. He maintains a stable, low posture while shifting each heavy weight with controlled, rhythmic motions. The studio lighting remains bright and even, highlighting his physique and the mechanical details of the gym equipment in the background as he completes the exercise set.
